description: Check whether the apparent absence of ADNP2 and ADNP from the human PF00096 set is real or a pagination artifact, and compare the zinc-finger recognition-position composition of ADNP2 against the human C2H2 background
code:
# =====================================================================
# Two checks on the previous cell.
# 1. "absent from the PF00096 set" may have been a pagination artifact:
#    the search returned exactly 400 results, which is the page size.
#    Ask InterPro directly whether Q6IQ32 and Q9H2P0 carry PF00096.
# 2. Are the ADNP2 recognition positions (-1, +2, +3, +6) unusual in
#    composition compared with human C2H2 fingers?
# =====================================================================
import requests, re, numpy as np
from collections import Counter
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
H = {"User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0"}

print("=" * 78)
print("1. InterPro signatures over the zinc-finger region")
for acc, name in [("Q6IQ32", "ADNP2"), ("Q9H2P0", "ADNP")]:
    j = requests.get("https://www.ebi.ac.uk/interpro/api/entry/all/protein/uniprot/%s/?page_size=200" % acc,
                     timeout=120, headers=H).json()
    hits = []
    for r in j["results"]:
        md = r["metadata"]
        locs = r["proteins"][0]["entry_protein_locations"] or []
        frs = []
        for L in locs:
            for f in L["fragments"]:
                frs.append((f["start"], f["end"]))
        hits.append((md["source_database"], md["accession"], md.get("name", ""), len(frs), frs[:3]))
    zf = [h for h in hits if re.search(r"zinc|C2H2|znf", (h[2] or "") + h[1], re.I)]
    print("\n  %s (%s): %d entries total, %d matching 'zinc/C2H2'" % (name, acc, len(hits), len(zf)))
    for db, a, nm, n, ex in sorted(zf):
        print("     %-12s %-14s n=%-3d %-42s %s" % (db, a, n, nm[:42], ex))
    pf96 = [h for h in hits if h[1].upper() == "PF00096"]
    print("     PF00096 (zf-C2H2) present:", bool(pf96), pf96[0][3] if pf96 else "")

# a direct count of how many reviewed human proteins carry PF00096
n_total = requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search?query=xref:pfam-PF00096+AND+organism_id:9606"
                       "+AND+reviewed:true&format=json&size=1", timeout=120, headers=H).headers.get("x-total-results")
print("\n  reviewed human proteins with a PF00096 cross-reference (UniProt total): %s" % n_total)
print("  the previous cell fetched only the first 400 of these, so 'absent from the set'")
print("  is only meaningful if InterPro also reports no PF00096 for the accession.")

# ---------------- 2. recognition-position composition
print("\n" + "=" * 78)
print("2. Recognition positions -1, +2, +3, +6")
STRICT = re.compile(r"C.{2,4}C.{12}H.{3,5}H")
LOOSE  = re.compile(r"C.{1,5}C.{9,15}H.{2,6}H")
def recog(seq, s, e, pad=4):
    w = seq[max(0, s-1-pad): min(len(seq), e+pad)]
    m = STRICT.search(w) or LOOSE.search(w)
    if not m: return None
    f = m.group(0); hi = [i for i, c in enumerate(f) if c == "H"]
    h = hi[0]
    if h - 7 < 0: return None
    return "".join(f[i] for i in (h-7, h-5, h-4, h-1))

q = ("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search?query=xref:pfam-PF00096+AND+organism_id:9606+AND+reviewed:true"
     "&format=json&size=400&fields=accession,gene_primary,ft_zn_fing,sequence")
j = requests.get(q, timeout=180, headers=H).json()
bg = []
for e in j["results"]:
    sq = e["sequence"]["value"]
    for f in e.get("features", []):
        if f["type"] == "Zinc finger" and "C2H2" in (f.get("description") or ""):
            r = recog(sq, f["location"]["start"]["value"], f["location"]["end"]["value"])
            if r: bg.append(r)
print("  background recognition quadruplets from human C2H2 fingers: n=%d" % len(bg))
POS = ["-1", "+2", "+3", "+6"]
for k in range(4):
    c = Counter(r[k] for r in bg)
    tot = sum(c.values())
    top = ", ".join("%s %.0f%%" % (a, 100*n/tot) for a, n in c.most_common(5))
    print("    pos %-2s  top residues: %s" % (POS[k], top))

# DNA-contact chemistry: R,K,N,Q,D,E,S,T,H are the residues that read bases in C2H2 fingers
CONTACT = set("RKNQDESTH")
bgfrac = np.array([sum(a in CONTACT for a in r)/4 for r in bg])
def zf_feats(acc):
    e = requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/%s.json?fields=sequence,ft_zn_fing" % acc,
                     timeout=90, headers=H).json()
    sq = e["sequence"]["value"]
    return sq, sorted((f["location"]["start"]["value"], f["location"]["end"]["value"], f.get("description",""))
                      for f in e.get("features", []) if f["type"] == "Zinc finger")
print("\n  fraction of the four recognition positions that are base-reading chemistry (RKNQDESTH)")
print("  human C2H2 background: mean %.3f, sd %.3f, n=%d" % (bgfrac.mean(), bgfrac.std(ddof=1), len(bgfrac)))
rows = {}
for acc, name in [("Q6IQ32", "ADNP2"), ("Q9H2P0", "ADNP")]:
    sq, zfs = zf_feats(acc)
    rs = [(i, recog(sq, s, e)) for i, (s, e, d) in enumerate(zfs, 1)]
    vals = [(i, r, sum(a in CONTACT for a in r)/4) for i, r in rs if r]
    rows[name] = vals
    m = np.mean([v[2] for v in vals])
    print("    %-6s %s" % (name, "  ".join("ZF%d=%s(%.2f)" % v for v in vals)))
    print("           mean %.3f, z = %.2f, percentile of per-finger background = %.1f"
          % (m, (m - bgfrac.mean())/bgfrac.std(ddof=1), 100*(bgfrac < m).mean()))

# ---------------- figure
fig, ax = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(12, 4.3))
ax[0].hist(bgfrac, bins=np.arange(-0.125, 1.26, 0.25), color="#9aa7c7", edgecolor="white", rwidth=0.9)
for nm, c in [("ADNP2", "#d1495b"), ("ADNP", "#e8a33d")]:
    m = np.mean([v[2] for v in rows[nm]])
    ax[0].axvline(m, color=c, lw=2.5, label="%s mean %.2f" % (nm, m))
ax[0].set_xlabel("fraction of the 4 recognition positions with base-reading chemistry")
ax[0].set_ylabel("human C2H2 fingers (n=%d)" % len(bgfrac)); ax[0].legend(fontsize=9)
ax[0].set_title("ADNP2 fingers keep ordinary recognition-position chemistry")
labs = ["ZF%d" % i for i, _, _ in rows["ADNP2"]]
ax[1].bar(range(len(labs)), [v[2] for v in rows["ADNP2"]], color="#d1495b")
ax[1].axhline(bgfrac.mean(), color="grey", ls="--", lw=1.2, label="human mean %.2f" % bgfrac.mean())
ax[1].set_xticks(range(len(labs))); ax[1].set_xticklabels(labs, fontsize=9)
ax[1].set_ylabel("fraction base-reading at -1, +2, +3, +6"); ax[1].legend(fontsize=9)
ax[1].set_title("Per-finger recognition chemistry, ADNP2")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
